items.title: What Does Applied Materials (AMAT) Gain From Its New Board Appointment?
items.summary: Applied Materials (NasdaqGS: AMAT) has appointed Akash Palkhiwala, CFO and COO of Qualcomm, to its Board of Directors and Audit Committee. Palkhiwala brings senior finance and operations experience from a major semiconductor company to Applied Materials' board. The board appointment reflects a focus on semiconductor industry expertise during a period of sector disruption and growth. items.title: Google agrees to settle UK app developers' lawsuit for $353 million
items.summary: LONDON, Aug 27 (Reuters) - Google has agreed to settle a mass London lawsuit brought on behalf of app developers for £260 million ($353.21 million), according to a deal published on Thursday.
